curation.notes: Rad51/Rad54 homology-search complex remodelling of donor dsDNA studied with two techniques: a custom multiplexed magnetic tweezers on torsionally constrained ~13.7 kb DNA (supercoiling/hat curves, constant force) and a LUMICKS C-Trap dual optical trap with confocal fluorescence (force clamp at 0.5-5 pN, force-extension, kymographs of GFP-Rad54). Organism given only as 'yeast'; in vivo DLC assay is not SMFS.

evidence.snippet: The trapping power was set to 7.5% during data collection, leading to a trap stiffness of ∼0.07 pN/nm.
To form DNA tethers, 5 µm streptavidin-coated polystyrene beads (0.004% [w/v] [Lumicks], diluted in running buffer) were trapped

entities.name: Rad54 (WT, R272Q, R272A; GFP-tagged for fluorescence)

evidence.snippet: Rad54, Rad54 R272Q, Rad54 R272A, Rad51, and Rad51-IIA were purified as described previously (Crickard et al. 2020b).
In eukaryotes, Rad51 catalyzes the homology search in coordination with the ATP-dependent motor protein Rad54.
